Info

Parameter bundle holding assembled streaming subsystem services.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.streaming.bundle.StreamingBundle(*, connection: IStreamConnection, raw_channel: IRawChannel, playback_controller: IStreamPlaybackController, dispatcher: IStreamDispatcher, binary_streamer: IBinaryProgramStreamer)[source]¶

Bases: object

Immutable container holding streaming subsystem role-specific services.

It defines:

attributes:
connection - IStreamConnection transport connection controller.
raw_channel - IRawChannel immediate command and byte transmitter.
playback_controller - IStreamPlaybackController motion playback.
dispatcher - IStreamDispatcher telemetry notification port.
binary_streamer - IBinaryProgramStreamer compiled bytecode streamer.
